preview.//: Produces an APK you can download and install directly on a phone. This is the build to use for testing — no Play Store, no review, no wait.

production.//: Produces an AAB, which is the only format the Play Store accepts.

android.//: Starts in internal testing rather than going straight to production. A remote-access app that reaches somebody's home computer should be installed by you, on your own phone, before it is installed by anyone else.
